theorem circle_identity (X N : ℕ) (a b c : ℕ → ℂ) :
    ∫ α in (0:ℝ)..1, expSum X a α * expSum X b α * expSum X c α * e (-(N * α)) =
      ∑ n₁ ∈ range (X + 1), ∑ n₂ ∈ range (X + 1), ∑ n₃ ∈ range (X + 1),
        if n₁ + n₂ + n₃ = N then a n₁ * b n₂ * c n₃ else 0 := by

proof_context.conclusion: For finite exponential sums `S_a,S_b,S_c` (`expSum`), `∫_0^1 S_a S_b S_c e(-Nα) dα = Σ_{n₁+n₂+n₃=N} a(n₁)b(n₂)c(n₃)`: the triple additive convolution evaluated at `N`.

records.note: [L] proves the product rule only for three finite ℕ-supported weights, in expanded form, with e(+nα) instead of e(-αn); there is no statement of the two-factor rule as such.

ends.snippet:
have key : ∀ α : ℝ, expSum X a α * expSum X b α * expSum X c α * e (-(N * α)) =
      ∑ n₁ ∈ range (X + 1), ∑ n₂ ∈ range (X + 1), ∑ n₃ ∈ range (X + 1),
        a n₁ * b n₂ * c n₃ * e (((n₁ + n₂ + n₃ : ℕ) - N : ℤ) * α) := by
    intro α
    rw [expSum, expSum, expSum, sum_mul_sum, sum_mul, sum_mul]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun n₁ _ => ?_
    rw [sum_mul, sum_mul]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun n₂ _ => ?_
    rw [mul_sum, sum_mul]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun n₃ _ => ?_
    have : (((n₁ + n₂ + n₃ : ℕ) - N : ℤ) : ℝ) * α = n₁ * α + n₂ * α + n₃ * α + -(N * α) := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [this, e_add, e_add, e_add]
    ring

proof_context.conclusion: The product `S_a S_b S_c e(-Nα)` of exponential sums expands to `∑ a(n₁)b(n₂)c(n₃) e((n₁+n₂+n₃-N)α)`, the coefficient-level form of transform of a convolution equals the product of transforms (three factors).

/-- The major arcs `𝔐_{δ₀,r}` [H, (10.5)], lifted from `ℝ/ℤ` to `ℝ`: intervals of radius
`δ₀r/(2qx)` around `a/q` for odd `q ≤ r`, and of radius `δ₀r/(qx)` for even `q ≤ 2r`,
where `gcd(a, q) = 1`. -/
def majorArcs (δ₀ r x : ℝ) : Set ℝ :=
  (⋃ (q : ℕ) (_ : 1 ≤ q ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ r ∧ Odd q) (a : ℤ) (_ : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ)),
      Set.Ioo (a / q - δ₀ * r / (2 * q * x)) (a / q + δ₀ * r / (2 * q * x))) ∪
  (⋃ (q : ℕ) (_ : 1 ≤ q ∧ (q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * r ∧ Even q) (a : ℤ) (_ : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ)),
      Set.Ioo (a / q - δ₀ * r / (q * x)) (a / q + δ₀ * r / (q * x)))

proof_context.conclusion: `majorArcs δ₀ r x` is the union of open intervals around `a/q`, `(a,q)=1`, lifted to ℝ.

/-- The value of the L-series of the sequence `f` at the point `s`
if it converges absolutely there, and `0` otherwise. -/
noncomputable
def LSeries (f : ℕ → ℂ) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑' n, term f s n

proof_context.conclusion: `LSeries f s = Σ' n, term f s n`, with `term f s n = f n / n^s` for `n ≠ 0` and `0` at `n = 0`: the Dirichlet series `Σ_{n≥1} f(n) n^{-s}`.

ends.snippet:
/--
For `1 < re s` the L-function of a Dirichlet character agrees with the sum of the naive Dirichlet
series.
-/
lemma LFunction_eq_LSeries (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < re s) :
    LFunction χ s = LSeries (χ ·) s :=
  ZMod.LFunction_eq_LSeries χ hs

proof_context.conclusion: For `1 < Re s`, the analytically continued `χ.LFunction s` equals `LSeries (χ ·) s`, i.e. `L(s,χ) = Σ χ(n) n^{-s}`.

/-- The Mellin transform of a function `f` (for a complex exponent `s`), defined as the integral of
`t ^ (s - 1) • f` over `Ioi 0`. -/
def mellin (f : ℝ → E) (s : ℂ) : E :=
  ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, (t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) • f t

proof_context.conclusion: `mellin f s = ∫_{t>0} t^{s-1} • f t`, which is `∫_0^∞ f(t) t^s dt/t`.

records.note: Mathlib's statement is for arbitrary `σ` under convergence hypotheses (the text's 'fast enough decay'); [L] uses `σ = 3/2`.

ends.snippet:
/-- The Mellin inverse transform of a function `f`, defined as `1 / (2π)` times
the integral of `y ↦ x ^ -(σ + yi) • f (σ + yi)`. -/
def mellinInv (σ : ℝ) (f : ℂ → E) (x : ℝ) : E :=
  (1 / (2 * π)) • ∫ y : ℝ, (x : ℂ) ^ (-(σ + y * I)) • f (σ + y * I)

proof_context.conclusion: `mellinInv σ F x = (1/2π) ∫ x^{-(σ+yi)} F(σ+yi) dy`, the integral `(1/2πi)∫_{σ-i∞}^{σ+i∞} F(s) x^{-s} ds` parametrised by `s = σ+iy`.

ends.snippet:
/-- The inverse Mellin transform of the Mellin transform applied to `x > 0` is x. -/
theorem mellinInv_mellin_eq (σ : ℝ) (f : ℝ → E) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hf : MellinConvergent f σ)
    (hFf : VerticalIntegrable (mellin f) σ) (hfx : ContinuousAt f x) :
    mellinInv σ (mellin f) x = f x := by
  let g := fun (u : ℝ) => Real.exp (-σ * u) • f (Real.exp (-u))
  replace hf : Integrable g := by
    rw [MellinConvergent, ← rexp_neg_image_aux, integrableOn_image_iff_integrableOn_abs_deriv_smul
      MeasurableSet.univ rexp_neg_deriv_aux rexp_neg_injOn_aux] at hf
    replace hf : Integrable fun (x : ℝ) ↦ cexp (-↑σ * ↑x) • f (rexp (-x)) := by
      simpa [rexp_cexp_aux] using hf
    norm_cast at hf
  replace hFf : Integrable (𝓕 g) := by
    have h2π : 2 * π ≠ 0 := by simp
    have : Integrable (𝓕 (fun u ↦ rexp (-(σ * u)) • f (rexp (-u)))) := by
      simpa [mellin_eq_fourier, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ h2π] using hFf.comp_mul_right' h2π
    simp_rw [neg_mul_eq_neg_mul] at this
    exact this
  replace hfx : ContinuousAt g (-Real.log x) := by
    refine ContinuousAt.fun_smul (by fun_prop) (ContinuousAt.comp ?_ (by fun_prop))
    simpa [Real.exp_log hx] using hfx
  calc
    mellinInv σ (mellin f) x
      = mellinInv σ (fun s ↦ 𝓕 g (s.im / (2 * π))) x := by
      simp [g, mellinInv, mellin_eq_fourier]
    _ = (x : ℂ) ^ (-σ : ℂ) • g (-Real.log x) := by
      rw [mellinInv_eq_fourierInv _ _ hx, ← hf.fourierInv_fourier_eq hFf hfx]
      simp [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (show 2 * π ≠ 0 by simp)]
    _ = (x : ℂ) ^ (-σ : ℂ) • rexp (σ * Real.log x) • f (rexp (Real.log x)) := by simp [g]
    _ = f x := by
      norm_cast
      rw [mul_comm σ, ← rpow_def_of_pos hx, Real.exp_log hx, ← Complex.ofReal_cpow hx.le]
      norm_cast
      rw [← smul_assoc, smul_eq_mul, Real.rpow_neg hx.le,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt (rpow_pos_of_pos hx σ)), one_smul]

proof_context.conclusion: Mellin inversion: `mellinInv σ (mellin f) x = f x` for `x>0` when the Mellin transform converges at `σ`, is vertically integrable and `f` is continuous at `x`.

ends.snippet:
/-- Mellin inversion on `ℜs = 3/2`. -/
theorem GoodSmoothing.eq_mellinInv {φ : ℝ → ℂ} {K c : ℝ} (hφ : GoodSmoothing φ K c) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 < y) :
    φ y = (1 / (2 * π)) • ∫ t : ℝ, (y : ℂ) ^ (-(((3 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I)) •
      mellin φ (((3 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I) := by
  have hvert : Complex.VerticalIntegrable (mellin φ) (3 / 2) := by
    rw [Complex.VerticalIntegrable]
    exact hφ.integrable_line (σ := 3 / 2) (by norm_num) le_rfl
  have h := mellinInv_mellin_eq (3 / 2) φ hy hφ.conv hvert (hφ.continuousAt y hy)
  rw [← h, mellinInv]

proof_context.conclusion: The instance used in [L]: `φ y = (1/2π) ∫ y^{-(3/2+it)} mellin φ (3/2+it) dt` for `GoodSmoothing φ`.

verification.reason: The display is the general Mellin inversion formula for any admissible σ; Mathlib `mellinInv`/`mellinInv_mellin_eq` (used by [L] in `GoodSmoothing.eq_mellinInv`) state exactly that, with `σ = 3/2` only the instance.

/-- **Fubini**: `h_H(t) = ∫_{|ξ| ≤ H/2π} e(ξ log t) ĝ(ξ) dξ`. -/
theorem hH_eq_fourier {H t : ℝ} (hH0 : 0 < H) (ht : 0 < t) :
    (hH H t : ℂ) = ∫ ξ in Icc (-(H / (2 * π))) (H / (2 * π)),
      Complex.exp (↑(2 * π * ξ * Real.log t) * I) * 𝓕 gC ξ := by
  set a := H / (2 * π)
  set L := Real.log t
  rw [hH_eq_conv hH0 ht, ← integral_complex_ofReal]
  have step1 : ∫ v, ((gL (L - v) * sH H v : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      ∫ v, ∫ ξ in Icc (-a) a, (gL (L - v) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (↑(2 * π * ξ * v) * I) := by
    refine integral_congr_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [ae_ne_zero_real] with v hv
    rw [integral_const_mul, ← sH_eq_integral hH0 hv]; push_cast; ring
  rw [step1, integral_integral_swap]
  · exact setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc fun ξ _ => integral_shift_char L ξ
  · have hg : Integrable (fun v => ‖gL (L - v)‖) := (integrable_gL.comp_sub_left L).norm
    have h1 : Integrable (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (volume.restrict (Icc (-a) a)) := integrable_const 1
    refine Integrable.mono' (hg.mul_prod h1) ?_ (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => ?_)
    · refine Measurable.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      exact (Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (measurable_gL.comp (measurable_const.sub measurable_fst))).mul
        (by fun_prop)
    · rcases p with ⟨v, ξ⟩
      simp only [Function.uncurry_apply_pair, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one,
        Complex.norm_real]
      exact le_rfl

proof_context.conclusion: `h_H(t) = ∫_{|ξ|≤H/2π} e(ξ log t) ĝ(ξ) dξ` with `g(u) = h(e^u)`; with `r = -2πξ` this is `∫_{-H}^{H} h̃(r) t^{-ir} dr`, i.e. `h_H` is Mellin-band-limited with `R = H`.

/-- `μ` is the Möbius function. If `n` is squarefree with an even number of distinct prime factors,
  `μ n = 1`. If `n` is squarefree with an odd number of distinct prime factors, `μ n = -1`.
  If `n` is not squarefree, `μ n = 0`. -/
def moebius : ArithmeticFunction ℤ :=
  ⟨fun n => if Squarefree n then (-1) ^ cardFactors n else 0, by simp⟩

proof_context.conclusion: `μ n = (-1)^{Ω(n)}` if `n` squarefree (`n = p₁…p_k` distinct, `Ω = k`), else `0`.

/-- The Type II sum [H, (3.9), (5.1)] with `v = 2`:
`∑_{m odd} (∑_{d > U, d | m} μ(d)) ∑_{n > V odd} Λ(n) e(αmn) η₂(mn/x)`. -/
noncomputable def typeII (α x : ℝ) (U V : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ m ∈ Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, if Odd m then (∑ d ∈ m.divisors.filter (U < ·), (μ d : ℂ)) *
    ∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, (if Odd n ∧ V < n then (Λ n : ℂ) * e (α * m * n) *
      (eta2 (m * n / x) : ℂ) else 0) else 0

proof_context.conclusion: `typeII α x U V = Σ_{m odd ≤ x} (Σ_{d|m, d>U} μ(d)) Σ_{n odd, V<n ≤ x} Λ(n) e(αmn) η₂(mn/x)`, i.e. `(1*μ_{>U})(m)` times the inner sum over `n>V`.

/-- The approximation of `2vα` induced by `2α = a/q + δ/x`: `2vα = a_v/q_v + δ/(x/v)` with
`q_v = q/(q,v)`, `a_v = a·v/(q,v)`, valid with `Q_v = Q/v` when `qv ≤ Q`. -/
theorem approx2_mul {α x δ Q : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (h : Approx2 α x δ a q Q) (hx : 0 < x) {v : ℕ}
    (hv : 1 ≤ v) (hqv : (q : ℝ) * v ≤ Q) :
    Approx2 (v * α) (x / v) δ (a * (v / Nat.gcd q v : ℕ)) (q / Nat.gcd q v) (Q / v) := by
  obtain ⟨hq, hcop, ⟨k, h2α⟩, hδQ, hqQ⟩ := h
  have hv0 : (0 : ℝ) < v := by exact_mod_cast hv
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  set g := Nat.gcd q v
  have hg : 0 < g := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ hq
  obtain ⟨q', hq'⟩ : g ∣ q := Nat.gcd_dvd_left q v
  obtain ⟨v', hv'⟩ : g ∣ v := Nat.gcd_dvd_right q v
  have hqd : q / g = q' := by rw [hq', Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg]
  have hvd : v / g = v' := by rw [hv', Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg]
  have hcop' : Nat.Coprime q' v' := by
    have := Nat.coprime_div_gcd_div_gcd (m := q) (n := v) hg
    rwa [hqd, hvd] at this
  rw [hqd, hvd]
  have hq'1 : 1 ≤ q' := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by rintro rfl; simp at hq'; omega)
  have hg0 : (0 : ℝ) < g := by exact_mod_cast hg
  have hq'0 : (0 : ℝ) < q' := by exact_mod_cast hq'1
  have hq'q : (q' : ℝ) ≤ q := by
    rw [hq']; push_cast; nlinarith [show (1 : ℝ) ≤ g by exact_mod_cast hg]
  refine ⟨hq'1, ?_, ⟨v * k, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- `(a v', q') = 1`.
    have h1 : IsCoprime a (q' : ℤ) := by
      have : (q' : ℤ) ∣ q := ⟨g, by rw [hq']; push_cast; ring⟩
      exact hcop.of_isCoprime_of_dvd_right this
    have h2 : IsCoprime ((v' : ℕ) : ℤ) (q' : ℤ) :=
      Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hcop'.symm
    exact h1.mul_left h2
  · -- `2vα = a v'/q' + δ/(x/v) + vk`.
    have : (a : ℝ) * v' / q' = a * v / q := by
      rw [hq', hv']; push_cast; field_simp
    push_cast
    rw [this]
    have h2 := congrArg (fun t => (v : ℝ) * t) h2α
    rw [div_div_eq_mul_div]
    field_simp at h2 ⊢
    linarith
  · have hQ0 : 0 < Q := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hqv
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hx, div_le_div_iff₀ hx (by positivity), one_mul] at hδQ
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (div_pos hx hv0), div_le_div_iff₀ (div_pos hx hv0) (by positivity),
      one_mul]
    have : |δ| * (q' * (Q / v)) ≤ |δ| * (q * Q) / v := by
      rw [show |δ| * (q' * (Q / v)) = |δ| * (q' * Q) / v by ring]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq'q hQ0.le) (abs_nonneg _)) hv0.le
    calc |δ| * (q' * (Q / v)) ≤ |δ| * (q * Q) / v := this
      _ ≤ x / v := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hδQ hv0.le
  · rw [le_div_iff₀ hv0]; nlinarith

theorem abs_muSum_one_le {U : ℝ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hU : 0 < U) :
    |muSum U q (2 * q) fun _ => 1| ≤ muBound U q := by
  have h2q : 1 ≤ 2 * q := by omega
  have h1 : |muSum U q (2 * q) fun _ => 1| ≤ 1 := by
    have := Prelim.abs_sum_moebius_div_coprime_le_one (U / q) h2q
    simpa [muSum] using this
  unfold muBound
  split_ifs with h
  · refine le_min h1 ?_
    have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
    have h2 : ((2 * q : ℕ) : ℝ) < U / q := by
      push_cast; rw [lt_div_iff₀ hq0]; nlinarith
    have := Prelim.abs_sum_moebius_div_coprime_le_log h2q h2
    have e1 : (muSum U q (2 * q) fun _ => 1) =
        ∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊U / q⌋₊, (if Nat.Coprime n (2 * q) then (μ n : ℝ) / n else 0) := by
      simp [muSum]
    have e2 : U / q / ((2 * q : ℕ) : ℝ) = U / (2 * q ^ 2) := by push_cast; field_simp
    rw [e1]; refine this.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [e2]; push_cast; ring
  · exact h1

proof_context.conclusion: `|∑_{m ≤ U/q, (m,2q)=1} μ(m)/m| ≤ muBound U q = min(1, 2.8(2q/φ(2q))/log(U/2q²))` (the log branch only when `2q² < U`).

      2 * (√(Real.log V) + 1 / √(Real.log V)) / √V := by

  have hlV : 0 < Real.log V := Real.log_pos hV

  have hkk : k * k = Real.log V := Real.mul_self_sqrt hlV.le

    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hVA] at hW; linarith [hW.1]
  have hW0 : ∀ W ∈ Set.uIcc V A, W ≠ 0 := fun W hW => by linarith [hpos W hW]
  have hsq0 : ∀ W ∈ Set.uIcc V A, √W ≠ 0 := fun W hW =>
    (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by linarith [hpos W hW])).ne'
  have hsq : ContinuousOn (fun W : ℝ => √W) (Set.uIcc V A) := Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousOn

    ContinuousOn.log continuousOn_id hW0

    ((Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn hlogc).div (continuousOn_id.mul hsq)
      fun W hW => mul_ne_zero (hW0 W hW) (hsq0 W hW)).intervalIntegrable
  have i4 : IntervalIntegrable (fun W => 1 / (W * √W)) volume V A :=
    (continuousOn_const.div (continuousOn_id.mul hsq)

  have i6 : IntervalIntegrable (fun W => (Real.log W - Real.log V) / (W * √W)) volume V A :=
    ((hlogc.sub continuousOn_const).div (continuousOn_id.mul hsq)
      fun W hW => mul_ne_zero (hW0 W hW) (hsq0 W hW)).intervalIntegrable
  -- `∫ (log W - log V)/W^{3/2} = G(A) - G(V)`, `G(W) = -2(log W - log V)/√W - 4/√W`.
  have hI6 : ∫ W in V..A, (Real.log W - Real.log V) / (W * √W) =

    have h2 := (hasDerivAt_const W (4 : ℝ)).div (Real.hasDerivAt_sqrt hW0'.ne') hs.ne'

    have hss : √W * √W = W := Real.mul_self_sqrt hW0'.le

    rw [show √W ^ 2 = W by rw [sq, hss]]
    ring
  have hmono : ∀ W ∈ Set.Icc V A, √(Real.log W) / (W * √W) ≤
      k * (1 / (W * √W)) + 1 / (2 * k) * ((Real.log W - Real.log V) / (W * √W)) := by
    intro W hW
    have hW1 : 0 < W * √W := mul_pos (by linarith [hW.1]) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by linarith [hW.1]))

    have key : √(Real.log W) ≤ k + (Real.log W - Real.log V) / (2 * k) := by
      rw [← sub_nonneg]
      have : k + (Real.log W - Real.log V) / (2 * k) - √(Real.log W) =

      rw [this]; positivity
    calc √(Real.log W) / (W * √W) ≤ (k + (Real.log W - Real.log V) / (2 * k)) / (W * √W) :=

      _ = _ := by ring
  have hJ := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hVA i1 ((i4.const_mul k).add (i6.const_mul _)) hmono
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (i4.const_mul k) (i6.const_mul _),
    intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
    integral_inv_mul_sqrt_eq hV0 hVA, hI6] at hJ
  refine hJ.trans ?_

  have hsV : 0 < √V := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hV0
  have hlA : Real.log V ≤ Real.log A := Real.log_le_log hV0 hVA
  have t1 : 0 ≤ k * (2 / √A) := by positivity
  have t2 : 0 ≤ 1 / (2 * k) * (2 * (Real.log A - Real.log V) / √A + 4 / √A) := by
    have : 0 ≤ Real.log A - Real.log V := by linarith
    positivity
  have e : 2 * (k + 1 / k) / √V = k * (2 / √V) + 1 / (2 * k) * (4 / √V) := by
    field_simp; ring
  rw [e]
  have e2 : k * (2 / √V - 2 / √A) + 1 / (2 * k) * (-2 * (Real.log A - Real.log V) / √A - 4 / √A -
      (-2 * (Real.log V - Real.log V) / √V - 4 / √V)) =
      k * (2 / √V) + 1 / (2 * k) * (4 / √V) - k * (2 / √A) -
        1 / (2 * k) * (2 * (Real.log A - Real.log V) / √A + 4 / √A) := by ring
  rw [e2]; linarith

theorem Gr_eq (s : ℂ) (δ : ℝ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : |θ| < π / 4) (hs : -2 < s.re) :
    Gr s δ θ = Gr s δ 0 := by
  have hmem : ∀ {t : ℝ}, |t| < π / 4 → t ∈ Ioo (-(π / 4)) (π / 4) := fun {t} h =>
    ⟨by linarith [neg_abs_le t], by linarith [le_abs_self t]⟩
  have h := (convex_Ioo (-(π / 4)) (π / 4)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
    (f := fun θ => Gr s δ θ) (f' := fun _ => (0 : ℂ)) (C := 0)
    (fun t ht => (hasDerivAt_Gr s δ (abs_lt.2 ⟨ht.1, ht.2⟩) hs).hasDerivWithinAt)
    (fun _ _ => by simp) (hmem (by rw [abs_zero]; positivity)) (hmem hθ)
  rw [zero_mul, norm_le_zero_iff, sub_eq_zero] at h

  have hsin : 0 ≤ Real.sin θ := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hθ0 (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])

  have hy2 : (τ / (π * |δ|)) ^ 2 = τ ^ 2 / D := by rw [div_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs δ]

  have hm' : τ < 1.5 * D := by rw [hD]; nlinarith [hm]
  have hyD : 100 * D ≤ τ ^ 2 := by
    have := mul_le_mul hy hy (by positivity) hτ0
    have e : 10 * π * |δ| * (10 * π * |δ|) = 100 * D := by rw [hD, ← sq_abs δ]; ring

  have hθ1 : θ ≤ 0.2799 := by rw [hθ, div_le_iff₀ hD0]; nlinarith

  have hSup := (abs_le.1 hSb).2
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ Real.sin θ := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hθ0 (by linarith)

  set c := Real.cos (2 * θ) with hcdef

    have h5 : θ ^ 5 / 100 ≤ θ * (0.00078367 * u) := by

    have e3 : θ ^ 3 = θ * u := by rw [hu]; ring

    have h1 : S ^ 2 ≤ u * B ^ 2 := by

    have h2 : B ^ 2 * (1 + 2.30042 * u) ≤ 1.15021 := by
      have hq : 0 ≤ 1.968654 - 0.730739 * (u + 0.0783441) := by linarith
      rw [hB]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hu1) hq, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hu0 hu0) (sub_nonneg.2 hu1)]
    have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + 2.30042 * u)
    have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hu0
    calc S ^ 2 * (1 + 2.30042 * u) ≤ u * B ^ 2 * (1 + 2.30042 * u) := h3
      _ = u * (B ^ 2 * (1 + 2.30042 * u)) := by ring
      _ ≤ u * 1.15021 := h4
      _ = 1.15021 * u := by ring
  have hS2 : S ^ 2 ≤ 0.0763529 := by
    by_contra hlt
    push Not at hlt
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlt.le hu0]
  have hc1 : 0.84729 ≤ c := by rw [hc]; linarith
  have hc0 : 0 < c := by linarith
  have hY : 100 ≤ τ ^ 2 / D := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hD0]; linarith
  have hY0 : 0 ≤ τ ^ 2 / D := by positivity
  have hDu : D * u = 0.1866 ^ 2 * (τ ^ 2 / D) := by
    rw [hu, hθ]; field_simp
  have e4 : (2 * π * |δ| * S) ^ 2 = 4 * D * S ^ 2 := by
    rw [hD, mul_pow, mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs]; ring

  have hθτ : θ * τ = 0.1866 * (τ ^ 2 / D) := by rw [hθ]; ring
  -- the prefactor
  have hbc : (2 * π * |δ| * S / c) ^ 2 ≤ 0.19402 * (τ ^ 2 / D) := by
    rw [div_pow, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity), e4]
    have hSu : S ^ 2 ≤ u := by rw [hu]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hS0 hSθ 2
    have hc2 : 0.7179 ≤ c ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    calc 4 * D * S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (D * u) := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSu hD0.le]
      _ = 4 * (0.1866 ^ 2 * (τ ^ 2 / D)) := by rw [hDu]
      _ ≤ 0.19402 * (τ ^ 2 / D) * c ^ 2 := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc2 hY0]
  obtain ⟨hsq1, hsq2⟩ := sqrt_consts (c := c) (by linarith)
  have hpre : (1 + (2 * π * |δ| * S / c) ^ 2) * √(π / (c / 2)) + √π / (c * √(c / 2)) ≤
      0.588 * (τ ^ 2 / D) := by
    have := mul_le_mul (add_le_add_left hbc 1) hsq1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have hpre0 : 0 ≤ (1 + (2 * π * |δ| * S / c) ^ 2) * √(π / (c / 2)) + √π / (c * √(c / 2)) := by
    positivity
  refine h.trans ?_
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
  calc Real.exp (-(θ * τ) + (2 * π * |δ| * S) ^ 2 / (2 * c)) *
        ((1 + (2 * π * |δ| * S / c) ^ 2) * √(π / (c / 2)) + √π / (c * √(c / 2)))
      ≤ Real.exp (-0.1065 * (τ ^ 2 / D)) * (0.588 * (τ ^ 2 / D)) :=
        mul_le_mul (Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by linarith)) hpre hpre0 (Real.exp_pos _).le
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- `E₂` for a geometric tail `E_B ρ_B^k + E_A ρ_A^k`. -/
noncomputable def E2g (B : ℝ → ℝ) (κ T0 EB' EA' ρB ρA : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  EB' * (2 * Z3g B T0 / (1 - ρB) + 2 * c3g κ T0 / (1 - ρB) ^ 2) +
    EA' * (2 * Z3g B T0 / (1 - ρA) + 2 * c3g κ T0 / (1 - ρA) ^ 2)

proof_context.conclusion: E2g is the geometric-series constant bounding the high zeros, which replaces the displayed tail bound.

/-- The first line of the error term at `T₀ = 10⁸/q`. -/
theorem first_line_le {q : ℕ} (hq1 : 1 ≤ q) (hq3 : q ≤ 300000) {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : |δ| ≤ 4 * 300000 / q) :
    (1e8 / q) * Real.log (q * (1e8 / q) / (2 * π)) *
      (6.11 * Real.exp (-0.1598 * (1e8 / q)) + 1.578 * expδ (1e8 / q) δ) ≤ 2.485e-19 := by
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  have hq1' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  have hq3' : (q : ℝ) ≤ 300000 := by exact_mod_cast hq3
  set T0 : ℝ := 1e8 / q with hT0
  have hqT : (q : ℝ) * T0 = 1e8 := by rw [hT0]; field_simp
  rw [hqT]
  have hL := L_le
  have hL0 := L_nonneg
  have hT1 : 1000 / 3 ≤ T0 := by rw [hT0, le_div_iff₀ hq0]; nlinarith
  have hT2 : T0 ≤ 1e8 := by rw [hT0, div_le_iff₀ hq0]; nlinarith
  -- the main part
  have hm := mul_exp_anti (c := 0.1598) (t₀ := 1000 / 3) (t := T0) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hT1
  have hc := exp_c_le
  have h1 : T0 * Real.exp (-0.1598 * T0) ≤ 1000 / 3 * 7.3551e-24 := by
    rw [show -0.1598 * T0 = -(0.1598 * T0) by ring]
    exact hm.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc (by norm_num))
  -- the `δ` part
  have h2 : expδ T0 δ ≤ Real.exp (-74) := by
    unfold expδ
    split_ifs with hδ0
    · exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    · rw [Real.exp_le_exp]
      have hd : |δ| ≤ 1.2e6 / q := by linarith [show (4 * 300000 / q : ℝ) = 1.2e6 / q by ring]
      have hdpos : 0 < |δ| := abs_pos.2 hδ0
      have hπ := Real.pi_lt_d4
      have hπ0 := Real.pi_pos
      -- `(πδ)² ≤ (π · 1.2e6/q)² ≤ T0²/700`
      have hpd : (π * δ) ^ 2 ≤ T0 ^ 2 / 700 := by
        have e1 : (π * δ) ^ 2 = (π * |δ|) ^ 2 := by rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs]
        rw [e1]
        have h3 : π * |δ| ≤ 3.1416 * (1.2e6 / q) := mul_le_mul hπ.le hd (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        have h4 : (3.1416 * (1.2e6 / q)) ^ 2 ≤ T0 ^ 2 / 700 := by
          rw [hT0, div_pow, mul_pow, div_pow]
          rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]
          rw [show (3.1416 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1.2e6 ^ 2 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2) * 700 =
            (3.1416 ^ 2 * 1.2e6 ^ 2 * 700) / (q : ℝ) ^ 2 by ring]
          exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num) (by positivity)
        exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h3 2).trans h4
      have hpos : 0 < (π * δ) ^ 2 := by positivity
      have : 700 ≤ T0 ^ 2 / (π * δ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hpos]; rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)] at hpd; linarith
      rw [neg_mul, neg_div, neg_le_neg_iff, mul_div_assoc]
      linarith
  have h74 : Real.exp (-74) ≤ 1e-32 := by
    rw [Real.exp_neg, inv_le_comm₀ (Real.exp_pos _) (by norm_num)]
    have := exp_nat_ge 74
    norm_num at this ⊢; linarith
  have hδ0 := expδ_nonneg T0 δ
  have hT0n : 0 ≤ T0 := by linarith
  calc T0 * Real.log (1e8 / (2 * π)) * (6.11 * Real.exp (-0.1598 * T0) + 1.578 * expδ T0 δ)
      = 6.11 * Real.log (1e8 / (2 * π)) * (T0 * Real.exp (-0.1598 * T0)) +
        1.578 * Real.log (1e8 / (2 * π)) * (T0 * expδ T0 δ) := by ring
    _ ≤ 6.11 * 16.5829 * (1000 / 3 * 7.3551e-24) + 1.578 * 16.5829 * (1e8 * 1e-32) := by
        gcongr
        exact h2.trans h74
    _ ≤ 2.485e-19 := by norm_num

/-- A generic residual bound: `Σ_b ‖S(α_b) − m A‖² ≤ 3(φ D² + E² + φ|m|² F²)` from the three pieces. -/
theorem sum_residual_le {q : ℕ} {T S' : ℝ → ℂ} {m A : ℂ} {β D E F : ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ α, ‖T α - S' α‖ ≤ D) (hD0 : 0 ≤ D)
    (hE : ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ‖S' ((b : ℝ) / q + β) - m * S' β‖ ^ 2 ≤ E ^ 2)
    (hF : ‖S' β - A‖ ≤ F) :
    ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ‖T ((b : ℝ) / q + β) - m * A‖ ^ 2 ≤
      3 * (q.totient * D ^ 2 + E ^ 2 + q.totient * ‖m‖ ^ 2 * F ^ 2) := by
  have hpt : ∀ b ∈ Bset q, ‖T ((b : ℝ) / q + β) - m * A‖ ^ 2 ≤
      3 * (D ^ 2 + ‖S' ((b : ℝ) / q + β) - m * S' β‖ ^ 2 + ‖m‖ ^ 2 * F ^ 2) := by
    intro b _
    have e : T ((b : ℝ) / q + β) - m * A = (T ((b : ℝ) / q + β) - S' ((b : ℝ) / q + β)) +
        (S' ((b : ℝ) / q + β) - m * S' β) + m * (S' β - A) := by ring
    rw [e]
    refine (norm_sq_add3_le _ _ _).trans ?_
    have h1 : ‖T ((b : ℝ) / q + β) - S' ((b : ℝ) / q + β)‖ ^ 2 ≤ D ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hD _) 2
    have h3 : ‖m * (S' β - A)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖m‖ ^ 2 * F ^ 2 := by
      rw [norm_mul, mul_pow]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hF 2) (by positivity)
    linarith
  calc ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ‖T ((b : ℝ) / q + β) - m * A‖ ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ b ∈ Bset q, 3 * (D ^ 2 + ‖S' ((b : ℝ) / q + β) - m * S' β‖ ^ 2 + ‖m‖ ^ 2 * F ^ 2) :=
        sum_le_sum hpt
    _ = 3 * ((Bset q).card * D ^ 2 + ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ‖S' ((b : ℝ) / q + β) - m * S' β‖ ^ 2 +
          (Bset q).card * (‖m‖ ^ 2 * F ^ 2)) := by
        rw [← mul_sum, sum_add_distrib, sum_add_distrib, sum_const, sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul,
          nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ ≤ 3 * (q.totient * D ^ 2 + E ^ 2 + q.totient * ‖m‖ ^ 2 * F ^ 2) := by
        rw [card_Bset_eq]; nlinarith

proof_context.conclusion: A residual bound $\sum_b|T(\alpha_b)-mA|^2\le3(\phi D^2+E^2+\phi|m|^2F^2)$ with $D$ the pointwise non-coprime error.

  have hz₂ : 0 < z₂ := by linarith
  have hs₁ : 9 ≤ Real.log z₁ := by rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hz₁]; exact h9
  have hs12 := Real.log_le_log hz₁ h12

    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hz, mul_comm]
  -- first term
  have hA := antitoneOn_mul_exp_neg (Q := fun s => s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ))
    (Q' := fun s => 3 / 2 * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (s₁ := 9) (s₂ := Real.log z₂) (p := 1 / 6)
    (fun s hs => by
      have := Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (x := s) (p := 3 / 2) (Or.inl (by linarith [hs.1]))
      convert this using 2; norm_num)
    (fun s hs => by
      have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith [hs.1]
      have e : s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = s * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_one_add' hs0.le (by norm_num)]; norm_num
      rw [e]

      nlinarith [hs.1])

    (s₂ := Real.log z₂) (p := 1 / 3) (fun s _ => hasDerivAt_id s) (fun s hs => by
      linarith [hs.1])

  have m2 : Real.log z₂ ∈ Icc 9 (Real.log z₂) := ⟨hs₁.trans hs12, le_rfl⟩

theorem abs_etaPlus_le_A {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : |etaPlus t| ≤ 1.94 := by
  unfold etaPlus
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ht, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  have h1 := abs_hH200_le ht
  have h2 := mul_exp_neg_sq_half_le t
  have e : -(1 / 2) * t ^ 2 = -t ^ 2 / 2 := by ring
  rw [e] at h2
  have h3 : 0 ≤ t * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2) := by positivity
  calc |hH 200 t| * t * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2) = |hH 200 t| * (t * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2)) := by ring
    _ ≤ 3.15 * (1 / 1.625) := mul_le_mul h1 h2 h3 (by norm_num)
    _ ≤ 1.94 := by norm_num

/-- `t |η₊(t)| ≤ 2.32` for `t ≥ 0` (cf. [H, (14.24)]: `1.19073`). -/
theorem mul_abs_etaPlus_le_B {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : t * |etaPlus t| ≤ 2.32 := by
  unfold etaPlus
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ht, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  have h1 := abs_hH200_le ht
  have h2 := phi_le_two_div_e t
  unfold phi at h2
  have h3 : 0 ≤ t ^ 2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2) := by positivity
  calc t * (|hH 200 t| * t * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2)) = |hH 200 t| * (t ^ 2 * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2)) := by
        ring
    _ ≤ 3.15 * 0.7358 := mul_le_mul h1 h2 h3 (by norm_num)
    _ ≤ 2.32 := by norm_num

theorem norm_S_etaStar_le_uniform {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (α : ℝ) :
    ‖S etaStar x α‖ ≤ 22.75 * (x / κ) := by
  have hκ : (0:ℝ) < κ := by rw [Helfgott.κ]; norm_num
  have hy0 : 0 < x / κ := div_pos hx hκ
  have hGi : IntegrableOn (fun w => (17 : ℝ) * phi w) (Ici 1) :=
    (integrable_phi.const_mul 17).integrableOn
  have key := norm_S_etaStar_le_of_pointwise_Ici (G := fun _ => 17) (α := α) hx one_pos
    (fun w (hw : 1 ≤ w) => norm_S_eta2_le_trivial (mul_pos (by linarith) hy0) α) hGi
  have h1 := integral_phi_Ici_one_le
  have h2 := integral_phi_Ioo_le (w₀ := 1) zero_le_one
  rw [integral_const_mul] at key
  refine key.trans ?_
  have h3 : (17 * ∫ w in Ici (1:ℝ), phi w) + 17 * ∫ w in Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, phi w ≤ 22.75 := by
    norm_num at h2; linarith
  calc x / κ * ((17 * ∫ w in Ici (1:ℝ), phi w) + 17 * ∫ w in Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, phi w)
      ≤ x / κ * 22.75 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hy0.le
    _ = 22.75 * (x / κ) := by ring

    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (p 0) (p k), ghatY y n * Real.log (((n : ℝ) + 1) / n) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, G i * ℓ i := by
  have hpmono : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → j ≤ k → p i ≤ p j := by
    intro i j hij hjk
    induction j, hij using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => exact le_rfl

  have hYy' : Y ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ y ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith) hYy (by norm_num)

  have hi' := Finset.mem_range.1 hi

theorem abs_mul_Ew_le (u : ℝ) : |u| * Ew u ≤ 0.37 := by
  have he := Real.exp_one_gt_d9
  set s := Real.exp u with hs
  have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.exp_pos u
  have hE : Ew u = s ^ 3 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) := rfl
  rcases le_or_gt u 0 with hu | hu
  · -- `|u| = −u ≤ e^{−u}`, so `|u| E ≤ s² e^{−s²} ≤ e^{−1}`
    have h1 : -u ≤ Real.exp (-u) := by have := Real.add_one_le_exp (-u); linarith
    have h2 : Real.exp (-u) * s = 1 := by rw [hs, ← Real.exp_add]; simp
    have h3 : s ^ 2 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) ≤ Real.exp (-1) := by
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (s ^ 2 - 1)
      have e1 : Real.exp (s ^ 2 - 1) * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) = Real.exp (-1) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      have := Real.exp_pos (-s ^ 2)
      nlinarith
    have h4 : Real.exp (-1) ≤ 0.37 := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg, inv_le_comm₀ (Real.exp_pos 1) (by norm_num)]; norm_num; linarith
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hu, hE]
    have hE0 : 0 ≤ s ^ 3 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) := by positivity
    calc -u * (s ^ 3 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2)) ≤ Real.exp (-u) * (s ^ 3 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hE0
      _ = s ^ 2 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) * (Real.exp (-u) * s) := by ring
      _ = s ^ 2 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) := by rw [h2, mul_one]
      _ ≤ 0.37 := h3.trans h4
  · -- `u ≤ e^{u−1} = s/e`, so `|u| E ≤ s⁴ e^{−s²}/e ≤ 4/e³`
    have h1 : u ≤ Real.exp (u - 1) := by have := Real.add_one_le_exp (u - 1); linarith
    have h2 : Real.exp (u - 1) = s * Real.exp (-1) := by rw [hs, ← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
    have h3 : s ^ 4 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) ≤ 4 * Real.exp (-2) := by
      have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (s ^ 2 / 2 - 1)
      have hp : 0 ≤ s ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
      have hsq : (s ^ 2 / 2) ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (s ^ 2 / 2 - 1) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hp (by linarith) 2
      have e1 : Real.exp (s ^ 2 / 2 - 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) = Real.exp (-2) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
      have := Real.exp_pos (-s ^ 2)
      nlinarith
    have h4 : 4 * Real.exp (-2) * Real.exp (-1) ≤ 0.37 := by
      rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
      have : Real.exp (-2 + -1) = (Real.exp 1 ^ 3)⁻¹ := by
        rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_neg]; congr 1; norm_num
      rw [this]
      have : (2.7 : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ Real.exp 1 ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by linarith) 3
      rw [mul_inv_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]; nlinarith
    rw [abs_of_pos hu, hE]
    have hE0 : 0 ≤ s ^ 3 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) := by positivity
    calc u * (s ^ 3 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2)) ≤ Real.exp (u - 1) * (s ^ 3 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2)) :=

      _ = s ^ 4 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) * Real.exp (-1) := by rw [h2]; ring

theorem ternaryGoldbachUpTo_1e27 : TernaryGoldbachUpTo (10 ^ 27) := by
  intro n hn h5 hle
  have hBG := binary_goldbach_input
  by_cases hsmall : n ≤ 4 * 10 ^ 18 + 3

    obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq⟩ := hBG (n - 3) hev (by obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hn; omega) (by omega)
    exact ⟨3, p, q, Nat.prime_three, hp, hq, by omega⟩
  · -- a prime `p ∈ [n − 4·10¹⁸, n − 4]` from rung `i` of the ladder
    push Not at hsmall
    have hi1 : 1 ≤ (n - 5) / 3927138875067072512 := by omega
    have hi2 : (n - 5) / 3927138875067072512 ≤ 254638308 := by omega
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hp1, hp2⟩ := Ladder.ladder_prime hi1 hi2
    have hpb : p ≤ n - 4 := by omega
    have hpa : n - 4 * 10 ^ 18 ≤ p := by omega

    obtain ⟨q, r, hq, hr, hqr⟩ := hBG (n - p) hev (by omega) (by omega)
    exact ⟨p, q, r, hp, hq, hr, by omega⟩
